narrative:
Contact-centre delivery cost is GBP 66M a year for 2,000 FTE across 29 contracts. The 15-minute interval forecast needs 1,946 FTE against 2,000 scheduled — a 54-FTE surplus overall, but DWP lines are 22 FTE short on Monday and Tuesday mornings.

Virtual agents contain 18% of contacts in month 3 of the 5-month adoption plan. Fall-back demand — contacts the virtual agent starts but cannot finish — runs at 31% on DWP intents and returns with 35% longer handle time. The blended plan models both, which legacy WFM tools cannot.

signals.title: Virtual-agent adoption plan — month 3 of 5
signals.source: Capita Contact Centre workforce planning (SDP model)
signals.excerpt: Containment at 18% across about 1,200 customer intents on the 2,000-FTE, 29-contract estate; fall-back-to-human rate 31% on DWP intents.

signals.title: Aspect WFM exits on 31 December 2026
signals.excerpt: A 15-minute interval forecasting model on Snowflake replaces the Aspect tool; FCS + Snowflake forecasting and capacity planning live by 4 December.
